thread:
IncidentBot: Paging: HIGH - Per-tenant observability gap for tenant cedarpoint-fin (enterprise VPC). Missing spans/logs/metrics for recent requests. Impact: customers reporting 502s and inability to correlate root cause. Paging oncall: Priya. 

Priya: I'm on it. brief summary? what shard/forwarder?

Sam: saw a spike at 10:12 UTC, traces stop at our gateway ingress for cedarpoint-fin. Logs still show requests hitting LB but no downstream spans. Metrics for p95 latency and error-rate for that tenant are flatlined on our per-tenant shard (shard-7).

Nina: looks like shard-7 forwarder to obs-bridge in their VPC lost the KMS role refresh token. We've got partial metrics via our aggregated aggregator, but tenant-level traces not present.

Priya: tag: @Rachel (CS) - are they actively impacted? any customer alerts?

Rachel: Cedarpoint's SRE on call has flagged an operational incident: users are seeing failed completions and increased retries. They're asking for ETA on restore and whether we have a mitigation. They've escalated to their internal ops.

Matt: quick check: forwarding process on hosts in shard-7 shows the process running but no TLS sessions to cedarpoint's collector since 10:10. netstat shows CONNECTED -> RESET occasionally. Could be cert rotation issue on their side or a role/lambda expiry.

Priya: ok short term mitigation: 1) route cedarpoint traffic to fallback shard (shard-3) with observed compatibility, 2) enable legacy-prefetch on gateway to surface raw logs to our central aggregator for their tenant until traces resume, 3) request cedarpoint to check their collector certificate/ingress firewall for inbound connections from our bridge.

Sam: I can cut the routing override. Need to run the routing policy patch: 
```
# run from infra-control prod
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/tenant-cedarpoint HTTP/1.1
{
  "route_override": "shard-3",
  "reason": "temporary mitigation - shard-7 forwarder connectivity loss",
  "expires_in": 3600
}
```

Priya: Sam please run that now and post the confirmation id. Also enable legacy-prefetch flag for cedarpoint (gateway config).

Sam: applying override now... `deploy-req-cedar-2723456795`

DeployBot: Route override applied: id deploy-req-cedar-2723456795, effective at 2723456810, TTL 3600s. 

Sam: enabled legacy-prefetch on gateway for cedarpoint: config change id cfg-cedar-2723456797. It will start streaming raw logs to central-agg in ~30s.

Nina: FYI, enabling legacy-prefetch will increase egress and tokenization cost. Prefetch will include request/response headers and body sampling (config: sample=1/100).

Priya: noted. Rachel, tell Cedarpoint SRE we have a temporary routing fallback and raw logs are streaming to our central agg. Ask them to validate whether their collector is receiving connections from our fallback bridge IPs. Provide this checklist to them: 
- Confirm collector certificate validity for CN and expiry
- Check inbound firewall rules allow bridge IPs 10.52.34.0/24
- Probe from their side: `curl https://<collector-host>:443/health --cacert /path/to/ca` and share output

Rachel: will send checklist now.

Matt: while routing override is active, watch for double-ingestion or duplication on metrics. I'll add a short de-dup window filter on ingest pipeline for cedarpoint to avoid noisy dashboards. Applying filter now: `ingest-filter add dedupe tenant=cedarpoint window=30s`

Sam: confirm: dedupe rule applied: id dedupe-cedar-2723456805

Priya: good. Next: can we replay missing traces from the shard-7 local buffer to the central collector? If forwarder process hasn't acked, we might be able to flush the buffer.

Nina: forwarder buffer is on-disk at /var/lib/forwarder/shard-7/buffer. We have a safe replay command but must coordinate with cedarpoint to avoid delivering out-of-order spans. Command: 
```
sudo /opt/forwarder/bin/replay --shard shard-7 --tenant cedarpoint --dest central-agg --rate 200r/s --preserve-ts
```
We need cedarpoint approval for replay (they must accept potential late-arrival traces).

Priya: Rachel, please ask cedarpoint if they consent to a buffered replay. If yes, we will schedule replay in 15 min and monitor p95 and trace arrival.

Rachel: Cedarpoint consents to replay but requests no more than 500r/s and that we notify them 5 min prior. They also want a post-mortem note once complete.

Nina: we can do 200r/s default, bump on request. I'll schedule replay for 10:40 UTC (approx 600s from now). Will log replay job id when queued.

Sam: monitoring: after route override there was partial recovery of synthetic checks to their dashboard. Still seeing gaps for some customers. Will keep watch and escalate infra if duplication or errors spike.

Priya: escalation path if replay fails or duplicates spike: 1) pause replay, 2) revert routing override, 3) open bridge debug session with cedarpoint SRE and our net team. Who owns net debug? Matt you own.

Matt: got it. I'll stand by for tcpdump/pcap requests and will coordinate with their SRE to check mutual TLS negotiation logs.

DeployBot: Replay job queued: replay-job-cedar-2723456822, scheduled 2723457000 (10:40 UTC), rate=200r/s, preserve-ts=true.

Priya: adding tasks to the thread so we don't lose them: 
- [Priya] coordinate live comms with Cedarpoint and run post-mortem (ETA after restore)
- [Sam] keep routing override/dedupe and monitor dashboards (1h watch)
- [Nina] run replay and watch for duplicate traces; abort if dup rate >5%
- [Matt] stand by for net debug and liaise with Cedarpoint SRE
- [Rachel] update Cedarpoint every 10 mins and collect their acceptance for replay

Sam: initial metrics: errors dropped ~40% after override, synthetic probes show 60% success for typical user flows. Still missing correlation ids in ~20% of requests.

Nina: replay started at 2723457005 -> job replay-job-cedar-2723456822 running. First burst shows ~3k spans queued, moving at configured rate.

Priya: monitoring trace arrival on jaeger/trace-ui for cedarpoint. If we see preserved timestamps and spans merge, we'll keep the replay until buffers empty.

Matt: performing tcpdump on bridge node shard-7 to capture TLS handshake errors: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 10.52.34.17 and port 443 -w /tmp/trace-handshake.pcap`

Sam: observed transient 502s from their collector, probably causing forwarder to reset connection. Not seeing persistent rejects. I'll keep the override until we confirm stable.

Nina: replay progress update: 30% complete, dup-rate 0.6%. within safe limit. Continuing.

Rachel: Cedarpoint confirmed they applied firewall allowance for bridge fallback IPs and rotated certs earlier today but cert chain looks valid now. They will keep watch.

Priya: good. tentative next steps: if replay completes and traces reappear and error-rate remains low for 30m, we'll remove routing override and close thread with postmortem. If not, escalate to platform-ops for a deeper root cause.

DeployBot: Replay job complete: id replay-job-cedar-2723456822, finished at 2723457410, total spans replayed=12,482, dup_rate=0.5%

Nina: confirming traces are visible in trace-ui with preserved timestamps for cedarpoint. Correlation for earlier errors now possible.

Sam: metrics: p95 latency returned to baseline, errors down to pre-incident levels. No further 502 reports in last 10m.

Priya: wrapping up: 
- remove routing override at expire or early if safe. Sam, please remove override now and monitor.

Sam: removing override: action id remove-req-cedar-2723457422. 

DeployBot: Route override removed: remove-req-cedar-2723457422 at 2723457430

Priya: thanks everyone. Rachel, I'll hand post-mortem draft to you for Cedarpoint review. For Platform: Nina/Matt/Sam, please capture timeline, root cause hypotheses (token/collector flaps + forwarder behavior), and replay notes for the PM. I'll schedule a 1-hour post-incident review.

Rachel: Cedarpoint acknowledged the mitigations and requested a follow-up within 24h. I'll coordinate the postmortem review with them.

Priya: closing live mitigation - moving to post-incident. If anything new appears, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
